$comment: What scripts/live-run.mjs runs for this leaf. Setup gives the bare `python` and `pip-compile` the commands use (bin/python is the system interpreter, so Command 6 can build a fresh venv from it, and bin/pip-compile comes from a pinned tools venv), seeds the git history the leaf requires committed before a run, and writes the two run records Command 5 compares - the leaf ships no training script, so Command 4 is skipped and the records carry the shape run_record.py writes: identical inputs, differing timestamps and metrics.

setup.run: python3 -m venv .venv-tools && .venv-tools/bin/pip install --quiet pip-tools==7.6.1 && mkdir -p bin && ln -s "$(command -v python3)" bin/python && ln -s "$PWD/.venv-tools/bin/pip-compile" bin/pip-compile

sha=$(sha256sum data/train.csv | cut -d' ' -f1); commit=seed; mkdir -p runs/run-a runs/run-b; for r in a b; do printf '{"seed": 42, "data": "data/train.csv", "data_sha256": "%s", "git_commit": "%s", "python": "3.12", "started_at": "2026-09-27T0%s:00:00Z", "finished_at": "2026-09-27T0%s:01:00Z", "metrics": {"auc": 0.9%s}}\n' "$sha" "$commit" "$([ $r = a ] && echo 1 || echo 2)" "$([ $r = a ] && echo 1 || echo 2)" "$([ $r = a ] && echo 1 || echo 3)" > runs/run-$r/run.json; done
git init -q && git config user.email lab@example.invalid && git config user.name 'Live Run' && git add -A && git commit -qm 'seed the lab inputs' && git rev-parse --short HEAD

steps.expect_reason: an empty diff IS the pass: the compared inputs match, so the command prints nothing and exits 0, which the runner asserts.

skip.4: train.py is the reader's own training script - the leaf ships no model code. The run records Command 5 compares are written by setup in the shape run_record.py records, with identical inputs and differing timestamps and metrics.
